messages.body:
You are working on GitHub issue #93: "[P3][feature] Add per-channel performance benchmarks"

## Issue Details
No performance baselines exist for channel operations. Without benchmarks, regressions are invisible.

### What to Benchmark
| Operation | Metric | All Channels? |
|-----------|--------|---------------|
| Message receive → event published | Latency (T0→T2) | Yes |
| Send message → platform delivery | Latency (T10→T11) | Yes |
| Media download | Time + throughput | Yes |
| Connection establishment | Time to first message | Yes |
| Dedupe cache lookup | ops/sec | Yes |
| Stream sender throughput | chunks/sec | 3 channels |

### Existing Infrastructure
- scripts/perf/baseline.ts — general perf testing
- scripts/perf/journey-baseline.ts — journey timing
- scripts/perf/profile.ts — profiling
- JourneyTracker in core provides T0-T11 checkpoints
- But NO per-channel dedicated benchmarks

### Fix
1. Create benchmark suite in packages/channel-sdk/benchmarks/
2. Use Buns built-in benchmarking or tinybench
3. Store baseline numbers in benchmarks/baselines.json
4. CI check that flags >20% regression on key metrics
5. Per-channel results in CI artifacts

### Acceptance Criteria
- Benchmark suite with core operations per channel
- Baselines stored in repo
- CI integration (optional: fail on major regression)
- Results readable in CI logs
- make check green

## YOUR TASK
1. First run /council to analyze this issue — get architectural review and recommendations
2. Then run /wish to generate a structured wish plan file with scope, acceptance criteria, and execution groups
3. You are DONE when the wish file is written to disk
